methods.description: Subtract the added constant from both sides, including negative or decimal solutions.
Add the subtracted constant to both sides.
Divide both sides by the nonzero coefficient, retaining fractional solutions.
Multiply both sides by the nonzero divisor.
Apply the same inverse when the pronumeral expression is on the right.
Distinguish an equivalent operation from the inverse that isolates the pronumeral.
Use a supplied solution in the original equation, then solve the resulting one-step equation for the constant.
Compare multiplication and division equations requiring opposite inverse operations.
